exact_authorized_transform.verification: Hash the committed prior template; replace the single model assignment; hash the result; compare with the root-supplied installed profile digest. The worker did not inspect live client configuration.

correction.initial_observation: The installed digest did not match the literal committed template history or newline/BOM variants. No arbitrary custom-profile replacement was authorized.
correction.new_evidence: The parent reported the existing Sol model assignment and its prior user authorization. Exactly one model substitution in the proven prior template yields the installed digest.
correction.verification_result: Exact digest match; only that transform and the unchanged prior template are recognized.
correction.arbitrary_custom_profiles: Refused even when their current digest is supplied.

implementation.final_delta_after_native_acceptance: Add the required --expect-profile-sha256 to the printed dry-run apply command; targeted migration test passed on the final source.
contract: Existing atomic_write implementation is reused; same-directory temporary file, fsync, expected current digest, atomic replacement.
Migration requires an exact recognized source digest and the caller's matching --expect-profile-sha256.
The prior profile is backed up before mutation; original mode and source ownership are journaled.
The replacing intent is journaled before replacement, so rollback can recover an interruption before completion journaling.
Rollback restores only when current bytes match the applied target and backup bytes match the recorded prior digest; later writers and modified backups cause a conflict.
Exact client-version guard, default idle guard, native config expectedVersion, daemon_auto_start=false and unknown-custom-profile refusal remain intact.

native_integration_acceptance.evidence_class: Local integration acceptance against the installed native executable; not unchanged upstream tests.
native_integration_acceptance.process_guard_note: The scratch process-name selector isolates this fixture from live clients. The global updater's default codex active-process guard was not changed or bypassed.
